title: feat(i18n): a dependent package's fieldPatches text is translated from that package's own translations
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBFyg5B2muWbKZjA9phXVWse)_

Fixes #33952
Also answers finding #34836 (S1 and N4, both pinned here). That card holds no claim on this branch, so the area shuts it by hand after the merge.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `TranslateDocumentOptions` gains an exported member, `patchBundles`; nothing accepted before is refused
Metadata-protocol: semantic — a dependent package's translations of its own `fieldPatches` text now take effect on `/meta` and on the public form; on a patched slot the pair `.custom` translation is laid over the package's locale by locale, so a pair that translates the slot only in a fallback locale (`en`) no longer wins over the package's translation in the requested one (`zh-CN`)
Skills-docs: follow-up #34785

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：依赖包用 `fieldPatches` 改写厂商对象字段的标签、说明、选项名后，这些文字现在按该依赖包自己的翻译显示(先 `.custom` 配对包的翻译，再依赖包的，最后原文)。
- 为什么改：之前补丁文字在所有语言下都原样显示英文，依赖包带的 zh-CN 翻译不生效;按卡上裁决 B(6942920667)落地。
- 风险与回滚：只影响被补丁改过的字段文字;没写补丁的字段、租户自改的文字、厂商自己的翻译都不变。Studio 在中文下整体保存时，写入门会把「税号」还原成补丁原文「Tax ID」再存(L2 M1 已修并钉往返测试)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`(`partCatalog` 选目录的顺序)、`packages/objectql/src/registry-platform-global.ts`(`getPackagedFieldPatchBases` 哪个包写了哪段文字)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts`(`getPackageTranslationBundle` 读单个包的翻译)。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-object-field-patch-i18n.test.ts`,预期全过，其中 [#33952] 一组断言补丁标签在 zh-CN 下读到「税号」。
- 需要你做的:contract review owed(L2 delta,spec 导出扩展);碰 `packages/spec/src` 走 Tier H 由席位交棒，治理面读数 NOT governed;审核记录在案前不求批。

## What changes

A code package that relabels a vendor's field with `fieldPatches` (ADR-0146 D10) now has that text translated from its **own** translations. Before, a patched label, help text, description or option label was served as the patch wrote it in every locale: a patched slot read only the pair `.custom` catalog, and the deployment catalog deep-merges every package's translations with the package ids dropped (`FileI18nAdapter.loadTranslations`), so the patching package's rows never reached the slot. Re-measured on `origin/main` dc66d330 before writing any code: the `/meta` item read served `{"label":"Tax ID","description":"Unified social credit code."}` under zh-CN with the dependent's zh-CN rows for both keys in the catalog.

Order on a patched slot, as ruled (6942920667, answering 6931518666):

1. the pair `.custom` package's translation of the key;
2. the translations of the code package whose patch wrote the served value (its shipped `translations`, then its own active `translation` rows);
3. the served text.

The owner's translation never applies to a patched slot (#29564 stays fixed). A slot no patch wrote (a tenant's rename on top) keeps its own text. Nothing is stamped on the served document: the writing package is found by comparison, the served value against the packaged base with that one package's patches applied (ADR-0029 D9.2a).

- `@objectstack/spec` — `TranslateDocumentOptions.patchBundles` (the name the seat analysis proposed); `translateObject` reads it on a changed field slot: label, help/description, option label, and through the same `slotCatalog` also `inlineTitle` and `relatedListTitle`. The pair is laid over each package's bundle locale by locale along the fallback chain (the interleaving ruling 6631250894 fixed for unchanged strings), so a pair that translates a patched slot only in `en` no longer wins over the package's `zh-CN`.
- `@objectstack/objectql` — `SchemaRegistry.getPackagedFieldPatchBases(name)`: one entry per enabled code package whose extension patches the object, highest precedence first, each the packaged base with only that package's `fieldPatches` applied. `getPackagedObjectBase` is unchanged and still never folds a patch in.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` — `getPackagedFieldPatchBases(name)` (the registry read, feature-detected) and `getPackageTranslationBundle(packageId)` (one package's translations, locale-keyed: its installed record's `translations`, then its own active rows bound by `package_id`).
- `@objectstack/rest` — the `/meta` object item and list reads and `GET /forms/:slug` pass `patchBundles` (memoised per package across a list page). The public form passes no `pairBundle` (on `main` too), so there a patched slot reads package, then text.
- **The save door's inverse** (`restoreTranslatedEchoes`, via `restoreTranslatedObjectEchoes`; L2 M1 on the first head): it now translates its sources with the read's `patchBundles` (read through two new `ProtocolHost` members), and each entry's patched base, cut to the fields its patch changed, is a source of its own between the stored row and the platform columns. So a zh-CN Studio GET then whole-body PUT of a patched label stores the patch text (`Tax ID`), not the package's translation (`税号`), over a stored row carrying the patch text and with no stored row; before the fix both stored `税号`, which every locale then served.

**Five packages became four.** The card expected a per-package translation copy kept by `II18nService` and the runtime. Read from code, neither is needed: `registerApp` → `installPackage(manifest)` keeps the converted manifest, `translations` included, on the package record (`getPackage(id).manifest`), so the protocol reads a package's own bundle from the registry. `II18nService` and `packages/runtime` are not touched. That read is pinned by `registry-field-patch-bases.test.ts` (a real `ObjectQL.registerApp`, then `getPackageTranslationBundle` over it).

## Tests

New:
- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.object-patch-bundles.test.ts` (8): patched label/help/option read the patching package's zh-CN; no `patchBundles` keeps the text; an untranslated locale keeps the patch text; a tenant rename keeps its text; two patching packages; the pair keeps the first rank; an entry with no base / no `packagedBase`; `translateMetadataDocument` passthrough.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry-field-patch-bases.test.ts` (4).
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.package-translation-bundle.test.ts` (5).

Extended (new `describe` blocks only, no existing assertion changed):
- `packages/rest/src/meta-object-field-patch-i18n.test.ts` (+5).
- `packages/rest/src/public-form-section-i18n.test.ts` (+2).
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-meta-effective-schema.test.ts` (+2): the zh-CN GET → PUT round trip on a patched label, with and without a stored row carrying the patch text; asserts the stored text is `Tax ID` and an `en` read serves it. Red on the first head `26d09ed6` before the fix: 2 failed, `expected '税号' to be 'Tax ID'` on the stored label.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-translated-echo.test.ts` (+3): the pure inverse with `patchBundles` (both sources), a tenant rename on an unpatched field kept, and no `patchBundles` ⇒ no restore.

Ablations (each restored, blob == HEAD):
- spec: patch rank made inert (`index < patchCatalogs.length` → `index < 0`) → `i18n-resolver.object-patch-bundles.test.ts` 5 failed | 3 passed (the three green are the keep-own-text cases).
- rest: `patchTranslationBundlesOf` made to return `undefined` → 4 failed | 33 passed across the two rest files (exactly the four [#33952] serving cases).
- door: `restoreTranslatedObjectEchoes` passes no `patchBundles` → round trip 2 failed (both legs).
- door: patch-base sources dropped (`[storedDoc, injectedDoc]`) → round trip 1 failed (no-row leg) | 1 passed (stored-row leg).
- door: the changed-fields cut dropped → `protocol-translated-echo.test.ts` 1 failed (the tenant-rename case) | 9 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, noted only: object-level `label`/`description` an extension sets through `objectExtensions` (not `fieldPatches`) may have the same gap; not measured.
- Not wired here: other `translateObject` callers (validation messages, formula `label()` and the like) still pass no `patchBundles`, so they serve a patched slot as before. The `/i18n/translations` detail read was not re-measured.
- Public form has no pair rank (older than this PR): filed as finding #34806.
- Not fixed here: a `/meta` conditional read can still answer 304 after a translation-only change of a patch bundle, since the validator hashes the served document and locale and no catalog (same standing as the deployment catalog and pair bundle today).
- Not fixed here: `patchTranslationBundlesOf` and the door issue one `sys_metadata` read per patching package (filtered in SQL, memoised per list page), where the pair read folds bindings into one `$in`.
- File surface: beyond the claim, `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts` + `public-form-section-i18n.test.ts` (the public form translates the same object) one paragraph in `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx`, the two ledger rows `check:engine-double-contract --write` added to `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`, and for M1 `protocol-translated-echo.ts`, `protocol-host.ts` and the host install in `protocol.ts`.
- Fix round (S1 and N4 of contract review 6948153780, written up as #34836), head `8510e0e9`: the door's inverse asked a patch entry for a slot even where the stored row declared that slot with its own text, so a stored `税号` equal to the patching package's zh-CN translation was rewritten to `Tax ID` on any whole-body save. Route: the first one #34836 names. A patch entry now answers a slot only where its patch changed that slot against the packaged base (per slot, not per field: N4), and only where the stored row does not declare the slot or carries the packaged text there (S1). The two pinned legs hold unchanged (a stored `Tax ID`; no row, so the packaged base is the source). Pins: `protocol-meta-effective-schema.test.ts` +1 (stored `税号`, an `en` whole-body save with an unrelated edit to `name`, through the real `saveMetaItem`: the stored label stays `税号` and the edit lands); `protocol-translated-echo.test.ts` +3 (the same at the pure layer; N4's catalog string typed over a tenant-renamed slot is kept; a slot the patch left alone is no patch source where the stored row does not declare the field). Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored with blob == HEAD: the S1 guard removed, metadata-protocol rebuilt, dist preflight `--absent` exit 0, gives pure 1 failed / 12 passed and door 1 failed / 24 passed, both `expected 'Tax ID' to be '税号'`; restored, rebuilt and preflight present gives 13/13 and 25/25. The per-slot cut removed gives pure 1 failed / 12 passed (`expected 'Registration number' to be '注册号说明'`, the slot-cut pin). The changeset and the `patchBundles` docblock are unchanged: their wording still matches. `origin/main` merged (one import-line conflict in `protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts`, resolved as the union of both). Local on `8510e0e9`: metadata-protocol 349 passed / 9 skipped, typecheck green; objectql typecheck green, `protocol-meta-effective-schema.test.ts` + `registry-field-patch-bases.test.ts` 29/29; rest patch files 37/37; the 52 gate families derived for this round's three paths all exit 0 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` first read NOT MEASURED for want of build state and the lock, then re-run green).
- Round S2 (contract review 6950554757, should-fix), head `70e332e8`: the stored half of the patch guard in `restoreTranslatedEchoes` was a second copy of the fold's comparison and differed on an empty string, so a stored `label: ''` on a patched slot let a zh-CN whole-body save store `税号` as the tenant's text. It now asks `scalarOverridesPackagedBase` (imported from `@objectstack/spec/system`) over the packaged field, option or object that holds the slot, the same call the fold makes. Pin: `protocol-translated-echo.test.ts` +1 (stored `''`, the zh-CN echo of the fold's `Tax ID`, restored to `Tax ID`). Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (guard put back to the old copy; pure suite imports `src`, no build): 1 failed / 13 passed, `expected '税号' to be 'Tax ID'`; restored blob == HEAD `196e74e7`, 14/14 green. Local on `70e332e8`: metadata-protocol 349 passed / 9 skipped (23103 tests), typecheck green; objectql door pins 29/29; rest patch files 37/37; 51 gate families derived for this round's two paths, 50 exit 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED (exit 3, no full-repo `dist/`; CI runs it).

## Verification

All on head `70347ee4` (the M1 rework with `origin/main` merged), on a shared box:

- Full suites (`pnpm --filter … run test`, under the verify lock), on `74ab926d` (the merge, before the docblock-only commit): spec 849 files / 27178 tests passed; metadata-protocol 349 passed, 9 skipped; objectql 607 / 13612 passed; rest 415 passed; `run typecheck` (incl. `check:test-typecheck`) green for all four. metadata-protocol re-run on `70347ee4` after moving two docblocks: 349 passed, 9 skipped; typecheck green.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 129 derived families, all `exit 0` on `70347ee4`; `--ran` reconciles 129 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The round before it found `check:facade-delegation-only` red (`protocol.ts` 12 lines over its ceiling once `main` was merged); fixed by moving the two new reads' docblocks to their facet bodies, leaving one-line pointers.
- First head `26d09ed6`: 129/129 gates, the same four suites green, CI 72 check-runs green. Two real reds of an earlier round fixed there: `check:engine-double-contract` and `check:test-source-alias`.
- Premise, before any code, on `origin/main` dc66d330: patched zh-CN read served `Tax ID` / `Unified social credit code.`; with this branch the same read serves the dependent's `税号` (pinned in `meta-object-field-patch-i18n.test.ts`).
